what.value: One read-only surface normalising cron, systemd timers, cyder and clicks into a single legible clock of the system's time-drivers.
what.quote: The Arxana Clock is the single surface that answers, at a glance: *what keeps this system ticking, when did each last fire, and when does it fire next?*

area.quote: and the place a **new** driver (e.g. an every-≈100-turns trigger) registers so it's visible rather than hidden.
